name: Ray-traced Isosurface Extraction on Tetrahedral Cells
definition: A parallel software rendering technique that computes isosurfaces for unstructured tetrahedral grids implicitly via ray tracing, treating each tetrahedron as an independent item and avoiding explicit polygon extraction.
summary: Ray-traced Isosurface Extraction on Tetrahedral Cells is a parallel software rendering technique that computes isosurfaces for unstructured tetrahedral grids implicitly via ray tracing, avoiding explicit polygon extraction to enable interactive rendering rates on parallel hardware.
